title: SkillProof Backend Sources Catalog
description: Authoritative frameworks, official standards, official documentation, professional references, interview preparation resources, and company-published interview guidance anchoring backend competencies.

sources.title: Backend Developer Roadmap
sources.notes: Community-curated visual reference guide for backend development skills and technologies. Widely adopted community framework; not an official accredited occupational standard.

sources.title: Skills Framework for the Information Age (SFIA 9) - Software Development (PROG)
sources.notes: SFIA 9 global competency framework defining software development behaviors across proficiency levels. Does not prescribe a single universal backend developer job definition.

sources.title: RFC 9110: HTTP Semantics
sources.notes: Authoritative Internet standard defining HTTP request methods, idempotency, safety, conditional headers, and status codes.

sources.title: RFC 7519: JSON Web Token (JWT)
sources.notes: Authoritative Internet standard defining compact, URL-safe claim representations and cryptographic signature validation.

sources.title: PostgreSQL Documentation: Using EXPLAIN
sources.notes: Official relational database engine documentation explaining query execution plans, index scans, cost estimation, and optimizer decisions.

sources.title: OWASP API Security Top 10 (2023)
sources.notes: Industry-standard security awareness resource cataloging critical security vulnerabilities in modern web APIs.

sources.title: Designing Data-Intensive Applications
sources.notes: Definitive professional engineering reference on database storage engines, transaction isolation, replication, and distributed systems.

sources.title: xUnit Test Patterns: Refactoring Test Code
sources.notes: Authoritative architectural reference cataloging test doubles (mocks, stubs, fakes, spies), assertion practices, and test code smells.

sources.title: Site Reliability Engineering: How Google Runs Production Systems
sources.notes: Industry engineering reference on cascading failures, distributed rate limiting, graceful degradation, and system reliability.

sources.title: The System Design Primer
sources.notes: Open-source community educational resource curating system design concepts, patterns, trade-offs, and interview preparation guides. Reclassified from candidate-reported-interview to interview-preparation-resource.

sources.title: LeetCode Database Problem #175: Combine Two Tables
sources.notes: Canonical SQL interview problem testing candidate understanding of LEFT JOIN vs INNER JOIN to preserve records without foreign key matches.

sources.title: System Design Interview – An Insider's Guide
sources.notes: Industry-standard interview preparation curriculum covering practical architectural patterns including distributed rate limiting, API pagination, and cache stampede mitigations.

sources.title: Amazon Jobs: Technical Interview Topics & Software Development Preparation
sources.notes: Official Amazon hiring documentation outlining technical assessment focus areas, explicitly highlighting data structures (Arrays, Hash Tables), object-oriented design, databases, and distributed systems.

sources.title: Google Tech Dev Guide: Data Structures and Algorithms Path
sources.notes: Official Google-published learning and interview preparation curriculum detailing arrays, hash table lookup complexities, bucket addressing, and collision handling.

sources.title: Stripe Engineering: Scaling your API with rate limiters
sources.notes: Authoritative engineering publication from Stripe frequently referenced in interview loops, detailing Token Bucket vs Sliding Window algorithms, Redis atomic coordination, and traffic burst management.

sources.title: Slack Engineering: Evolving API Pagination at Slack
sources.notes: Official Slack engineering publication analyzing production database performance degradation with offset pagination and justifying cursor/keyset pagination for scalable APIs.

sources.title: Google Testing Blog: Testing on the Toilet: Know Your Test Doubles
sources.notes: Google engineering guidance defining mocks, stubs, and fakes, explaining behavioral verification versus state verification in automated unit testing.

sources.title: Google Testing Blog: Flaky Tests at Google -- Tools and Mitigation
sources.notes: Google engineering publication documenting test non-determinism root causes in CI, including shared mutable state, timing dependencies, and isolation strategies.

sources.title: Meta / USENIX NSDI '13: Scaling Memcache at Facebook
sources.notes: Seminal engineering paper by Facebook/Meta infrastructure engineers documenting the cache stampede (thundering herd) problem under read load and lease/mutex mitigation mechanisms.

sources.title: MongoDB Documentation: Data Model Design
sources.notes: Official MongoDB documentation detailing embedded subdocument vs reference relationships, atomicity, and schema design access patterns.

sources.title: Redis Documentation: Redis Data Types and In-Memory Architecture
sources.notes: Official documentation covering Strings, Hashes, Sets, Sorted Sets, and single-threaded in-memory execution guarantees.

sources.title: Redis Documentation: Key Eviction and Memory Management (maxmemory-policy)
sources.notes: Official Redis specification describing LRU, LFU, volatile vs allkeys eviction algorithms, and maxmemory limits.

sources.title: Microsoft Learn: Asynchronous programming with async and await in C#
sources.notes: Official Microsoft language reference explaining Roslyn state machine compilation, Task/ValueTask allocations, and thread pool execution.

sources.title: Microsoft Learn: Dependency injection in ASP.NET Core
sources.notes: Official ASP.NET Core architecture guide detailing Transient, Scoped, and Singleton lifetimes and warning against captive dependencies.

sources.title: Microsoft Learn: Memory- and span-related types in .NET
sources.notes: Official .NET documentation detailing stack value types, reference types, GC overhead, and zero-allocation Span and Memory representations.

sources.title: Oracle Java Documentation: Concurrency and Thread Synchronization
sources.notes: Official Java SE documentation covering thread lifecycles, synchronized locks, memory visibility, and thread-pool execution.

sources.title: Spring Framework Documentation: Core Technologies & AOP Transaction Management
sources.notes: Official Spring reference documentation detailing IoC bean creation, AOP proxy interceptor behavior, and transaction rollback rules.

sources.title: JEP 444: Virtual Threads
sources.notes: Authoritative Java Enhancement Proposal standard introducing user-mode virtual threads, carrier thread mounting, and pinning constraints.

sources.title: The Python Language Reference: Data Model and Generator Execution
sources.notes: Official CPython language specification defining hashability, dictionary table structures, iterator protocol, and generator frames.

sources.title: Python Standard Library: asyncio — Asynchronous I/O
sources.notes: Official Python documentation describing event loops, coroutines, non-blocking tasks, and offloading to worker threads via asyncio.to_thread.

sources.title: FastAPI Documentation: Concurrency and async / await Execution
sources.notes: Authoritative FastAPI guide explaining asynchronous event loops, path operation thread pools for def vs async def, and request concurrency.

sources.title: CppReference: Resource Acquisition Is Initialization (RAII) and Smart Pointers
sources.notes: Authoritative C++ reference on deterministic stack unwinding, destructor execution, unique_ptr, and move semantics.

sources.title: CppReference: Concurrency Support Library and Atomic Operations
sources.notes: Authoritative C++ memory model and concurrency specification defining data races, memory orderings, and atomic primitives.

sources.title: Effective Modern C++: 42 Specific Ways to Improve Your Use of C++11 and C++14
sources.notes: Canonical professional C++ reference detailing smart pointers, move semantics, perfect forwarding, and concurrency hazards.

sources.title: Node.js Documentation: The Node.js Event Loop, Timers, and process.nextTick()
sources.notes: Official Node.js architecture guide explaining phases of the libuv event loop, microtask draining, and worker execution.

sources.title: Node.js Documentation: Stream API and Backpressure Handling
sources.notes: Official Node.js stream specification detailing chunk buffers, highWaterMark limits, backpressure flow control, and stream.pipeline.

sources.title: The TypeScript Handbook: Narrowing, Discriminated Unions, and Generics
sources.notes: Official TypeScript language specification defining structural typing, compile-time type erasure, discriminated unions, and mapped types.

sources.title: Zod Documentation: TypeScript-first schema validation with static type inference
sources.notes: Industry-standard schema validation library documentation bridging runtime API boundary validation and compile-time TypeScript types.

sources.title: Effective Go: Interfaces, Slices, and Concurrency
sources.notes: Official Go language design reference explaining implicit interface satisfaction, slice headers, and idiomatic error return values.

sources.title: Go Blog: Go Concurrency Patterns: Pipelines and cancellation
sources.notes: Official Go engineering publication detailing bounded worker pools, context cancellation propagation, and goroutine leak prevention.

sources.title: The Rust Programming Language: Ownership, Borrowing, and Lifetimes
sources.notes: Official Rust foundational book defining ownership invariants, reference borrowing rules, drop semantics, and Result error handling.

sources.title: Tokio Documentation: Asynchronous Programming in Rust and Shared State
sources.notes: Authoritative documentation for the Tokio runtime covering async tasks, Send/Sync bounds, async mutexes, and Pin guarantees.
